name: plate-notepad
prompt: Lofi anime still life, no people. A SMALL POCKET NOTEBOOK LYING OPEN on a cheap desk, seen from almost straight above, filling the upper half of the frame: cheap ruled paper, both facing pages COMPLETELY BLANK, a thin wire spiral along the spine, one corner slightly curled, a cheap ballpoint pen resting across the lower page, a chipped mug and a phone face-down beside it. The paper is the brightest thing in the picture. Late-night desk lamp from the left, cool violet ambience elsewhere. IMPORTANT STYLE RULES: same overall BRIGHTNESS as the reference images, do NOT make this darker or more cinematic; same SATURATED blue-violet and lilac palette with cyan accents, do NOT desaturate toward grey; same FLAT lofi-anime cel shading, minimal gradients, no depth-of-field, no bloom. **ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, NO WRITING, NO MARKS ON THE PAGES — the pages must be completely blank.** The text is composited later.
